basic_info.description: Enjoy modern and luxury living in San Francisco's vibrant Richmond district. A completely renovated stunner with an unmatched blend of style, comfort, and location. This expansive 2.5 level home boasts over 2,500 living sqft with 5 bedrooms and 5 beautifully appointed bathrooms, including 3 luxurious master ensuites thoughtfully spread out. The top level is dedicated to a private master suite a serene retreat featuring a spa-inspired bathroom and generous closet space, offering both premium comfort and seclusion. Every inch of this exquisite home has been reimagined with high-end finishes and modern touches. Step into the main level and be greeted by the sophisticated sun-filled interior featuring contemporary fixtures and wide-plank hardwood flooring with an open layout flowing seamlessly into the designer kitchen. The designer kitchen features top-tier stainless steel appliances, sleek quartz countertops, wood custom cabinetry, and an elegant waterfall island. The private backyard oasis awaits, ideal for relaxing or entertaining hosts for gatherings. Experience picturesque views directly across from Golden Gate Park and Ocean Beach, top-rated restaurants, local shops, and cultural destinations like Legion of Honor and Sutro Baths all just minutes away.
